question: Pravda, alebo nepravda: chlieb zostane mäkký dlhšie v chladničke ako v chlebníku pri izbovej teplote.
source_excerpt: refrigeration speeds up starch retrogradation, the process that makes bread stale

extra.why_interesting: People assume the fridge keeps everything fresh longer. For bread it does the opposite: the cold speeds up staling, which is not drying out but starch turning back into crystals.
extra.verification_notes: Refrigeration accelerates starch retrogradation so bread stales faster in the fridge than at room temperature, making 'Nepravda' correct (https://www.chowhound.com/1572579/never-store-bread-in-refrigerator).

explanation: Nepravda. Chlieb nestvrdne preto, že vyschne. Stvrdne preto, že sa škrob v ňom znova kryštalizuje, a v chladničke to ide až niekoľkokrát rýchlejšie. Ak ho chcete uchovať dlho, patrí do mrazničky.
